name: OnlyDefense
source:
OnlyDefense is a humorous erotic tower defense game, in which you play dream battles at night against factions that are attempting to seduce you. Each faction has unique abilities, upgrades and towers and your performance and luck influence the story as well as story choices and dice rolls against abilities.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3708000]Steam[/url]]
translation:
OnlyDefense是一款幽默的色情塔防游戏，你可以在夜间与试图引诱你的派系进行梦幻之战。每个派系都有独特的能力、升级和塔楼，你的表现和运气会影响故事以及故事选择和能力的骰子。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3708000]Steam[/url]]
